headlines.text: 2026 brought us this moment: Will Ospreay vs. Mark Davis met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 8.64 ? an incredible outing. With their rivalry already boiling over, Ospreay and Mark Davis of the Don Callis Family threw down for the first time ? a preview of the no-interference Mexico City street fight still to come.
Flash back to 2022, when Athena stepped through the curtain for the first time against Kiera Hogan, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.94.

Turning the clock back to 2020: Cody vs. Jungle Boy fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.18 ? a good, competitive contest. It was the first title opportunity of Jungle Boy's career. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2026: MJF vs. Rush settled things in a No Count Outs match, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 7.73 ? a solid showing.
2022 brought us this moment: The Young Bucks vs. The Lucha Brothers delivered a genuine showstealer on Rampage, rated 8.80.
Looking back to 2026, when Kevin Knight vs. Mike Bailey clashed for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.52 ? a well-worked match.
